description: The Swedish Energy Agency publishes official annual energy balances through PxWeb table EN0202_A. The table metadata expose years 2005–2024, 96 balance rows and 44 energy commodities. Balance categories distinguish production, imports, exports, transformation, distribution losses and final consumption by sectors including industry, transport and households. Users can select MWh, GWh, TWh, TJ or thousand tonnes of oil equivalent. Coverage is national, with yearly updates; the inspected table was updated on 30 April 2026 and identifies reference year 2024. Public variable selection is free and the table explicitly states that copyright does not apply. Access is through the statistical web table; export formats were not tested. A limitation is that national accounting aggregates cannot describe individual networks or hourly operating constraints, and overlapping totals must not be added to their component rows. Simulation uses include calibrating national energy balances and sector demand scenarios. It complements data-eurostat-energy-statistics, with definitions requiring comparison before combining the sources. The separate agency catalogue contains other tables that are not claimed as individually reviewed here. No data cells were queried or downloaded.
